projectDescription: A web-based multimedia equipment loan management system for Instituto Superior Brazo Oriental, allowing students to check out and return equipment with digital signatures and an admin dashboard.
keyFeatures: Equipment checkout form with digital signature capture (Canvas API)
Equipment return workflow with active loan lookup by national ID
Admin dashboard with KPI metrics (today's loans, active, returned, delayed)
Pending alerts for loans overdue by more than 12 hours
Full loan history with date-range filtering and search by name or ID
PDF report export (full or pending-only) via html2pdf.js
Editable loan records from the admin panel
Responsive design with accessible ARIA attributes
Inactivity timer on the return view (auto-redirects after 5 minutes)
SELinux-aware server permission repair script for CentOS 9
publicApiSurface: POST api/auth.php?action=login — Admin login with username/password
GET api/auth.php?action=check — Check current session status
POST api/loans.php — Create a new equipment loan (public)
GET api/loans.php?action=active_by_ci&ci={ci} — Get active loans by national ID (public)
PUT api/loans.php — Return a loan with signature (public) or update status/details (admin)
GET api/loans.php?action=pending — Get all active/pending loans (admin)
GET api/loans.php?action=all — Get full loan history (admin)
GET api/loans.php?action=stats — Get dashboard KPI statistics (admin)
SignaturePad class — Canvas-based digital signature with mouse/touch support and Base64 export
API.createLoan(loanData) — JS client method to register a checkout
API.getActiveLoansByCI(ci) — JS client method to look up active loans
API.returnLoan(id, signatureBase64, observation) — JS client method to register a return
API.updateLoanStatus(id, status, observation) — Admin JS method to change loan status
API.updateLoanDetails(id, updates) — Admin JS method to edit loan fields
